releaseNotes: AURA 3.5.0 - the trust release: stem spectrum curves now match your EQ (4096-pt true-stereo analysis; the old 1024-pt mono fold painted phantom low end and under-read wide stems by up to 10 dB - the root of bad Auto-Mix advice). Plus multi-solo groups on the spectrum (kick+sub+bass together), the Glass & Glow visual pass with a Mix Score dial and free window resizing, and interface cleanup (Send MIDI Now hidden unless a port exists).
